Definition: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration
BiblicalUsage: 1) number, tale; 1a) number; 1a1) number; 1a2) innumerable (with negative); 1a3) few, numerable (alone); 1a4) by count, in number, according to number (with prep); 1b) recounting, relation
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
